title: Jorjani invited to join the Knights of Malta in an initiation ritual in Malta

tellings.quote: Yeah. I was invited, by the way, to join the Knights of Malta at one point.

plain: The philosopher Jason Jorjani says he was once invited to join the Knights of Malta, an old Catholic order of knights, through an initiation ritual held on the island of Malta. He tells it as something that happened to him, mentioning it in passing: "I was invited, by the way, to join the Knights of Malta at one point."
